_comment: Swim R5 D3 (STOP): the game's own answer for L5's kill lock on r8-solve-5's staging. `witness` is the refuted (uncommitted) tape r5-arrow-killlock: r8-solve-5's keys to t 328, its walk from t 462, then `down` x120. The game (seedling_bot_ap_p4e, headless, `check-seedling-bot-differential.mjs --record --only=r5-arrow-killlock`, recorded twice, identical) passes lock@48,112 on t 423 and crosses to L6 on t 424; the model holds the player at y 108.55 until its declared clear {5,0}@427 and crosses on t 429. `bodies` is `probe-seedling-u9-shield-mobiles.mjs --tape=r8-solve-5 --class=Bob` on the committed tape: the clock calibrates (shift [0]) and the bodies diverge from t 54.

tape.name: r5-arrow-killlock
tape.description: R5-swim D3: `r8-solve-5`'s staging and keys to t 340 (`arrowtrap@32,48` kills `bob@48,80`, L5's last body, on t 326), then its own walk to `lock@48,112` from t 430, ninety ticks earlier, and `down` held into the lock. The player stands on the lock before a removal-timed opening and crosses onto `teleporter@48,112` (L6) the tick it opens: the game answers whether a KILL's kill lock opens at the kill or at the removal.
